title: Intermittent order create — api-gateway hitting client timeouts to orders-api
symptoms: circuit breaker or retry storms toward one dependency
downstream p95 much higher than in-process work
end-to-end latency dominated by waiting on a dependency
observed_signals: timeout logs named a specific dependency, not the local database
db utilization rose only where the caller held connections during the wait
retries increased request rate slightly without a user-traffic surge
caller CPU and memory stayed close to baseline

timeline.event: api-gateway began retrying calls to orders-api
circuit breaker or retry logs referenced orders-api
orders-api recovered or was isolated; caller errors receded

contributing_factors: the caller had no fallback for that route
resolution: capped retries to stop amplifying load on orders-api
worked with the dependency owners on saturation of their pool
added synthetic checks against orders-api from the same region
lessons_learned: fallback and circuit breaking should be tested, not only documented
held DB connections during a slow downstream call are a side effect of waiting, not a saturated local pool
